text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking across the plaza, I 
spotted Hokko Tarumae talking with Oguri 
Cap.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san is a truly great person who put 
her hometown of Kasamatsu on the map, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even with all the popularity she's gained 
from performing here, she never forgets 
her hometown...! A level of fame truly 
befitting an idol Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I really look up to them...! As a local 
idol!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"So please, could you offer some advice to 
your junior local idols?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Locodol...? What is that?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me! "Locodol" means a local 
idol.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They're also called local idols; they're 
idols who base their activities in 
regional areas.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It also plays a role in regional 
revitalization, so promoting local 
specialties and events is part of the 
activities as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That was very educational. Thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No, in that case, I'm glad to hear it—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, not that! Um, if possible, I would 
like you to teach me the secret to 
becoming popular!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a secret... the secret, huh. I 
wonder...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I hadn't thought about what I was doing 
nearly as deeply as you have."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I just wanted to see everyone back home 
smiling. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Oguri-san.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... it doesn't look like I can be of any 
help to you. I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No! That is not the case.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Cherishing your hometown is the most 
important thing for a local idol, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad I got to hear how Oguri-san 
feels about Kasamatsu!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you and I were the same in 
that regard.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Then, perhaps I'm a local idol too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yes, definitely!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's both do our best for our hometowns. 
As local idols, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. Actually, you see... I 
was giving Oguri-san some tips on how to 
make it big as a local idol—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: I missed my chance to ask for tips.
I missed my chance to ask for tips, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes... Were you listening?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I got completely swept up in 
Oguri-san's pace.
choice_data_list: Let's make sure we can set our own pace.
Isn't that the whole trick to it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But breaking Oguri-san's pace seems 
like it would be quite difficult with just 
ordinary effort.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I need to become a local idol who can 
compete on a whole other level...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Oguri Cap, Hokko Tarumae's 
local idol spirit blazed brightly.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Controlling the flow of the venue might 
indeed be the single most important thing 
in an idol's career...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A legendary Umadol really is on another 
level, huh... I'm taking notes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gained valuable lessons, Hokko 
Tarumae felt her love for her hometown 
grow all the stronger.
